rationale: The only implementation delta is the placement of cifs_small_buf_release(req): the vulnerable version releases the request buffer immediately after cifs_send_recv, before later trace accesses to req fields, while the fixed version releases it after response and error/success processing. The Logic section states only that resources are released before returning, which is true of both versions and does not specify the release timing relative to response processing or trace operations. All other described steps are shared by both implementations.
